approval_ref: The active user goal requires advanced-model reference analysis with CRIP management and lightweight, local, verifiable page selection without pre-model engineering-semantic reconstruction.
notes: Keep LEGACY_ANALYSIS as the default and retain legacy questions and QA V2.
REFERENCE_QA performs local parse/OCR only and must make no model call during preparation.
Page selection reads immutable parser source evidence only; it must not use Canonical nodes, embeddings, extracted records or model-vision narration.
QA V3 uses the selector but retains its bounded decision loop and exact-answer contract.
Tests use local fixtures and MockTransport only.
title: Add reference-QA preparation and transparent local page selection
acceptance_tests: python -m pytest tests/app/test_page_selector.py tests/app/test_evidence_loop.py tests/app/test_project_qa_v2.py tests/app/test_gateway_budget.py -q
objective: Add an opt-in parse-only reference run and a deterministic, bounded, auditable source-page selector, then route QA V3 evidence acquisition through it without changing existing default product paths.
